_comment: Houses whose NEW products default to 'cut' instead of 'keep' when scripts/refresh.mjs or scripts/add-brands.mjs first sees them (lib/lifecycle.ts::nextDecisions). This inverts the DEFAULT only — an existing decision, including a 'keep' Tina has made, is never touched. It is for a house she curates piece by piece: without it, emptying a brand lasts one night, because the nightly refresh defaults every new arrival to 'keep' and republishes it. Removing a slug here does NOT resurrect anything already cut; it only changes what happens to ids seen for the first time afterwards.
